shots.caption: Voice readback on, tone first. One button per tone, so you can learn them with the helmet on.
shots.alt: The Voice card on the alerts settings page at phone width: voice readback enabled, a Tone first toggle switched on, a line explaining rising, three quick and falling tones, and three buttons labelled Bird up, Bird near and All clear.

shots.caption: Tapping through the three tones. The clip is silent; your phone is not.
shots.alt: A phone-width clip of the Voice card: the Bird up, Bird near and All clear buttons are tapped in turn, each lighting up briefly as its tone plays.

shots.caption: The same card on desktop, under the proximity ping.
shots.alt: The alerts settings page at desktop width with the sidebar, scrolled to the Voice card showing Tone first and the three tone buttons.
